labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Feature request for a generic SpeedColumn; not yet approved in Discussions.

body:
Rich requires feature requests to be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start the proposal there.

Existing options that may already cover part of this:

- `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` shows speed when the total is unknown, using the fixed `it/s` format.
- Subclassing [`ProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) lets you render `task.finished_speed or task.speed` with your own unit.

Related: #3835 covers speed in `TaskProgressColumn`.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
